The AI model is missing (2.6 GB, downloaded only once).

Tap “Download and install the model”: it downloads with a progress bar and turns on by itself when finished (better on Wi-Fi). After that, the app works offline.

If you already have the file gemma-4-E2B-it.litertlm on your phone, tap “I already have it” and choose it.
📥 Download and install the model (2.6 GB)
Ready. Tap a language and speak.
📂 I already have it: choose the file
Copying model… this may take a few minutes

SimulTrans uses these open-source components:

• AI model Gemma 4 E2B © Google, Apache 2.0 license.
• LiteRT-LM engine © Google, Apache 2.0 license.
• The assistant’s Internet search: data from Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0 license) and news headlines from Bing and Google News, used only as context for the answer.

The Apache 2.0 license is at www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.
